messages.author: Louis Choquel (Pipelex)
messages.content:
## [Louis Choquel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/louischoquel/)

*Co-founder & CTO @ [Pipelex](https://pipelex.com/)· Pipelex is an open-source language for repeatable AI workflows. Build modular pipes that connect like LEGO blocks, each using its optimal LLM. Turn custom AI code into shareable, versioned pipelines with guaranteed outputs. [Python library available now](https://github.com/Pipelex/pipelex), hosted API coming soon.*
I'm a repeat entrepreneur in tech. Started in digital media distribution (music, VOD, peer-to-peer), then found success in social gaming (free-to-play games on Facebook and mobile). I was born in Sweden and speak Swedish fluently but I'm really a French guy.

Pipelex is my first open-source project, so I'm in full learning mode.

Special power: Modern rationality. Not Hollywood rationality (like Mr. Spock) but rather the art of fighting biases, seeking truth, and making decisions that work.

📍 Paris, France (CET)
